description: Search for satellites by name or keyword. Returns matching satellites with their NORAD IDs and TLE data.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Name or keyword to search for (e.g. "ISS", "Starlink", "GPS").

name: search_satellites

epoch.description: Epoch date of the TLE set

line1.description: First line of the Two-Line Element set

line2.description: Second line of the Two-Line Element set

norad_id.description: NORAD catalog ID of the satellite

total.description: Total number of matching satellites found

title: Search Satellites
